title: Muslim Muna Adhan Prayer Quran
description:
Welcome to Muslim Muna, a comprehensive Islamic educational app designed to enrich your understanding of Islam and strengthen your faith in Allah. Packed with powerful features, Muslim Muna offers complete Quranic teachings, authentic Hadith collections, highly accurate prayer times with azan reminders, and an extensive library of daily Duas and supplications with multi-language translations. Whether you are looking to deepen your Islamic knowledge, learn the pillars of faith, or enhance your daily spiritual practices, Muslim Muna is the perfect all-in-one companion for every Muslim.

📖 Holy Quran & Quran Majeed:
Read and listen to the full Holy Quran with high-quality audio recitations and multiple translations. Easily open any Juz or Surah directly from the index, add any ayah to your bookmarks or personal notes, and enjoy many useful features designed for better readability offline.

🕌 Prayer Times & Salah Reminder: 
Get highly accurate prayer times based on your current location, complete with an automatic athan alarm. This professional Namaz time feature sends you timely adhan notifications, ensuring you never miss a prayer again, Insha Allah. Perfect for tracking daily salah and prayer schedules offline

🤲 Supplications - Duas:
Access daily duas with audio recitation and multi-language translations. Easily listen to and understand the meanings, making it simple to incorporate these authentic Islamic prayers into your daily routine and azkar.

✨ 99 Names of Allah: 
Discover the beautiful 99 Names of Allah (Asma-ul-Husna), where you can listen to audio recitations and read detailed descriptions of each name. Learn the meanings and significance behind these beautiful Allah names. Perfect for daily reflection and spiritual growth!

🕋 5 Pillars of Islam: 
Explore the 5 Pillars of Islam feature, providing clear and concise explanations of each pillar. Learn about Shahada (Faith), Salah (Prayer), Zakat (Charity), Sawm (Fasting), and Hajj (Pilgrimage) in simple terms to strengthen your Islamic core knowledge. 

📖 Hadith Collection: 
Read a comprehensive collection of authentic sayings and Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) along with their translations. A valuable resource to guide your daily life through authentic Hadith books.

🕌 Near Mosques Finder:
Find nearby masjid effortlessly with our Near Mosques Finder feature. This GPS-powered mosque locator helps you find the nearest Muslim prayer halls and mosque near me to perform your Salah in congregation (Jamaat).

🗓️ Islamic Calendar and Date Converter:
Access the smart Islamic calendar (Hijri calendar) to keep track of important dates, holy months, and upcoming Islamic festivals. Easily convert between the Islamic and Gregorian calendars to ensure you never miss a celebration or observance. 

📿 Tasbeeh Counter & Dhikr:
Experience the digital tasbeeh counter like a real tasbeeh in your hand. This smart dhikr counter and zikirmatik also includes soothing sound effects for each count, giving you the perfect feel of using a physical tasbeeh offline. 

🕋 Qibla Finder & Compass: 
Easily locate the exact Qibla direction towards Mecca for your prayers, wherever you are. Our high-precision Qibla compass ensures you always face the correct direction of the Kaaba for your Salah.

💰 Zakat Calculator:
Easily calculate your Zakat according to your savings, income, gold, silver, and other assets. Stay accurate, manage your charity seamlessly, and fulfill your fundamental Islamic obligation with ease.

🕌 Step-by-Step Prayer Guide:
Learn and follow the correct steps for all daily prayers (Salah), including Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha. This visual Namaz guide is perfect for beginners and those seeking to improve their prayer habits.

✔ Feedback & Support:
We warmly welcome your suggestions, recommendations, and improvement ideas. Send your valuable feedback at muslimapps@hotmail.com
Please remember us in your prayers.
